tickets.title: BankSim balanced journal and balances
description: Implement accounts, opening equity, journals, postings, DB lock discipline; ETB as signed int64 minor units.
acceptance: Every journal sum=0; insufficient funds leave balances unchanged; 100 concurrent attempts cannot overspend.

tests: TestConcurrentLedgerEffects on isolated PostgreSQL: 100 same-key + 100 distinct concurrent attempts; balanced journals

tickets.title: BankSim transfer/settlement lifecycle
description: Implement `CREATED → ACCEPTED → SETTLEMENT_PENDING → SETTLED` and terminal `FAILED` with invalid-transition rejection.
acceptance: A synthetic 2,500 ETB payment and later settlement have correct postings; same idempotency key produces one financial effect.

tests: TestConcurrentLedgerEffects on fresh isolated PostgreSQL: CREATED, ACCEPTED, SETTLEMENT_PENDING, SETTLED, FAILED, invalid transition, failed retry without journal

tickets.title: Scenario controller
description: Implement deterministic seed/virtual clock; `normal_flow`, `delayed_settlement` first; other faults after vertical slice.
acceptance: Advance with stale `expected_step` is 412; scenario repeat yields same logical events independent of generated IDs.

tests: tests/e2e_demo.py: same-seed logical replay and stale expected_step=412

tickets.title: Signed BankSim provider events

tests: tests/e2e_demo.py: signed delivery, duplicate replay, tampered and expired rejection

tickets.title: SettleGraph durable inbox
description: Authenticate webhooks, persist deduplicated raw/normalized observations, enqueue via transactional outbox.
acceptance: 10 deliveries of identical event create exactly one logical observation; crash/restart safely replays.

tickets.title: Worker, retries, source coverage
description: Implement worker job leases, retries, DLQ/local equivalent, cursors and provider `complete_through` watermarks.

tests: tests/e2e_demo.py: provider outage yields no false missing case and recovery restores settlement
tests/e2e_delivery_recovery.py: pending provider event is redelivered after BankSim restart; inbox, healthy watermark, cursor and reconciliation recover
